hierarchy.purpose: Predominant light composition, breathing room and ordinary surfaces.
Structure, context, readable information and secondary comparisons.
Selective attention, active relations and the guiding dot.

review: Judge the whole composition, visual weight, geometry, negative space and contrast. Do not impose pixel quotas or a fixed background split.

surfaces.item: Small individual objects use solid gray or primary-red fill, with no border and readable internal text.
surfaces.group: Containers use white interiors and discreet outlines to avoid large colored background regions.

additionalColors.when: Exceptionally, when multiple entities, categories or independent data lines need additional distinct colors.
additionalColors.identity: Keep the entity-to-color mapping stable across views. Preserve real photo and logo identity.
